Title: Public Preview: Redis 7.2 on Azure Cache for Redis Enterprise

Body.Content: Enterprise and Enterprise Flash tier caches now support Redis 7.2 in preview. This latest version of Redis offers over a dozen new commands and performance enhancements over Redis 6.0, the previous version offered on Azure Cache for Redis. New features include expanded geospatial functionality, sharded pub/sub, and support for the RESP3 protocol.  Learn more.
